source_context.creator: Adam Smiarowski
source_context.caption_hook: I talk to Supply Chain Directors regularly.
caption_argument_segments: I talk to Supply Chain Directors regularly.
One pattern keeps showing up. The gap between what they expected from Agentic AI and what actually happened after go-live.

1. It works best on repetitive decisions, not strategic ones. The biggest wins came from high-volume, rule-based calls. Expedite or not. Allocate or hold. Not from strategy. The system handles the noise. People handle t…
2. Deployment takes 6–9 months, not 6 weeks. Vendors promise fast. Reality is slow. Change management, data cleanup, process redesign. None of that fits in a sprint.
3. The biggest win isn't the outcome. It's decision transparency. Planners stopped asking "why did the system do that?" They started understanding it. Teams work differently once that shift happens.
